answer: Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. The price of trying is £22 per docket, and 95 dockets before the first reward is released, paid up front for every single name, while the thread stays small. To join, a name must pass Declared carver workshop seal, which works because a seal carvers renew after grain hearings. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The clerk notes orchard. Every pearl is counted once.
